The JavaScript distribution is bundled byte-for-byte from the official npm 5.2.0 tarball. Aureus loads it only from the application bundle and does not use a CDN or runtime npm dependency. `market-chart.html` and `aureus-market-chart.js` are Aureus integration files and are not represented as upstream TradingView artifacts.

TradingView attribution is presented as a native SwiftUI link outside the isolated WebView.
